title: Anthony Hopkins finds Feifer's annotated copy of The Girl from Petrovka

tellings.quote: Heading for home, he chanced upon a book on a bench at the Lester Square tube station.

plain: The actor Anthony Hopkins is said to have stumbled on a copy of the novel The Girl from Petrovka, by the writer George Feifer, lying on a bench at Leicester Square tube station in London around 1972, and the copy turned out to be Feifer's own annotated one. The skeptic writer Michael Shermer tells it without naming a source: Hopkins was "heading for home" when he "chanced upon a book on a bench." It is told as a striking coincidence, the kind that seems to mean more than chance.
